content.text: The evidence is clear and consistent. I can now record the verdict.

input.explanation: The physical driver license card (f009:p7) clearly shows EXP 06-02-2026, issued 05-28-2022. The MVR report (f009:p5) shows Exp Date: 06/02/2030, reflecting a CDL renewal processed on 06/02/2026 per the Miscellaneous State Data entries. The license card predates the renewal and therefore carries the older expiration date — the two documents genuinely disagree, confirming the finding that the card is outdated relative to the MVR.
